plan.desired_state: A 15-second vertical Instagram Reel presenting the three trip photos in order, each animated for 5 seconds, with legible place-name captions and music.

plan.say: I’ll turn your photos into a short travel Reel with gentle motion, place captions, and instrumental music. What place name should I use for each photo?

steps.why: Define the three-stop travel short, retaining the supplied photo order and equal screen time.

params.extra: Kind: short; audience: general; platform: Instagram Reels; await the three place names before running.
params.prompt_or_change: Plan a 15-second travel memory short in three consecutive 5-second scenes using the supplied trip photos, gentle motion, place-name captions, and instrumental music.

steps.why: Register the original photos and the caption and music requirements for the short.

params.extra: Preserve each photo's recognizable location; use the user-confirmed place names.
params.prompt_or_change: Build an asset bank from the three original photos, their confirmed place names, and a gentle instrumental music direction.

steps.why: Specify the exact timing, motion, captions, and soundtrack.

params.extra: Use the story included in the asset bank; photo order p1, p2, p3; intervals 0–5, 5–10, 10–15 seconds; render captions as deterministic text, not generated image lettering.
params.prompt_or_change: Write a 15-second Instagram Reels screenplay with gentle photo animation, each confirmed place name placed legibly near the bottom within safe margins, and continuous instrumental music.

steps.why: Prepare vertical framing from the supplied photos without inventing replacement locations.

params.extra: Use the original photo assets referenced in the screenplay; reserve caption-safe space.
params.prompt_or_change: Prepare three vertically framed photo scenes with subtle pan-and-zoom paths, retaining the main subjects and leaving text for final compositing.

steps.why: Animate each photo for exactly five seconds.

params.extra: Three clips of 5 seconds each; use deterministic photo pan-and-zoom motion.
params.prompt_or_change: Create the three sequential five-second photo-motion clips following the embedded screenplay, preserving the original photographs.

steps.why: Assemble the Reel with readable place captions and music.

params.extra: Use code-rendered captions with the exact confirmed place names; hard cuts at 5 and 10 seconds; music spans all 15 seconds with a short ending fade.
params.prompt_or_change: Assemble a 15-second vertical Reel, overlay each scene's exact place name legibly within safe margins, and add continuous gentle instrumental music.
